Što propisuje javni poziv: What the public call sets out
Javni poziv EnU-2/26 Fonda za zaštitu ok: Public call EnU-2/26 of the Environmental Protection and Energy Efficiency Fund was published on 9 October 2026. After postponements, applications are scheduled to open on Thursday 5 November at 9:00 via the eFZOEU system. The grant for electric passenger cars is up to 40% of the eligible price, subject to fixed caps. Before applying, check the latest amendments and documents on the Fund's official website.
Pravo imaju punoljetne fizičke osobe s p: Eligible applicants are adults resident in Croatia, for one eligible vehicle. Hybrids and electric bicycles are not covered. The vehicle must be new; purchase with own funds or a loan and financial leasing are eligible under the terms of the call. Operating leases are not eligible. The grant is paid after the vehicle has been bought and registered and the required proof submitted. Financing for the purchase must therefore be arranged in advance, with special rules for financial leasing described below.
<strong>Važno:</strong> Nakon podnošenja: Important: Once submitted, an application cannot be changed or supplemented, and the same applicant cannot submit a new one. Applications are processed in the order received. Prepare the required documents before applications open. Final eligibility depends on the Fund's conditions and the individual application.
Vozilo u cijelosti plaćeno prije objave: A vehicle paid in full before the call was published on 9 October 2026 is not eligible. A deposit is eligible if it was incurred and paid no earlier than 1 January 2026; paying a deposit is not required to apply. The vehicle must be bought and registered by 31 March 2028, and the complete payment request submitted by 30 April 2028. The vehicle must be kept in ownership or use for two years from the date the Fund pays out.
Kod financijskog leasinga korisnik prije: With financial leasing, before requesting payment the beneficiary must pay the down payment and instalments totalling at least the approved grant. Remaining obligations under the lease must be settled no later than five years from the date the grant is paid (FZOEU, answer 12). Financing for the full purchase must be arranged, but leasing does not require paying the full price before the grant is paid.

Da, kupnja u drugoj državi EU-a prihvatl: Yes, buying in another EU country is eligible according to the Fund's clarification.
Vozilo mora ispuniti definiciju novog vo: The vehicle must meet the call's definition of a new vehicle, be type-approved for road use in Croatia and, after purchase, be registered for the first time in Croatia. A previous regular registration in another country is not eligible. The Fund does not regard trade, export (for example Zoll) or transferable plates as registration for the purposes of the call. Documents in a foreign language require a translation into Croatian certified by a sworn court interpreter.
Kod kupnje novog vozila iz EU-a u prijav: When buying a new vehicle from the EU, the application states the vehicle's value including Croatian VAT. An advertised foreign price should therefore not automatically be compared with the Croatian price on the invoice. Ask for an offer that clearly separates the vehicle price, VAT and additional costs.
Dostava i homologacija nisu dodatni poti: Delivery and type approval are not an extra grant.
Troškovi dostave, pripreme, homologacije: Costs of delivery, preparation, type approval, issuing the COC, documentation and other related costs that are not part of the vehicle price are not included in the co-financing base. Compare the total cost of getting the car on the road, including translation and transport, and ask the seller for written confirmation of the registration history.

The Fund sets no maximum mileage for such vehicles, but they must meet the definition of a new vehicle and all other conditions of the call. A “demo” label in an advert is not sufficient proof of eligibility.
